settings.hero_heading: Kneel. Flip. Sit. Get up easy.
settings.hero_text: A padded kneeler and a garden stool in one folding steel frame. With handles, so getting up is not the hard part any more.
settings.check_1: Kneeler one way up, stool the other. Thick detachable pad.
settings.check_2: Steel frame with handles you can push up on.
settings.check_3: Arrives assembled. Folds flat and snap-locks for the shed.
settings.packs_heading: Just the kneeler, or the whole kit.
settings.packs_text: Add the tool set and the bag hangs off the kneeler. Two kneelers if you share the beds. Prices are live from the store.
settings.handles_heading: Getting down is easy. Getting up is the part that hurts.
settings.handles_text:
A cushion on the ground helps your knees. It does nothing for the moment you have to stand. The handles on this frame sit at about hip height when you kneel, so you push up with your arms instead of your knees and back. Flip it over and those same handles are the legs of a stool.

The frame is steel. The pad clips off so you can hose it down.
settings.faq_heading: The things people ask before they buy.
settings.closer_text: Free US shipping. 30 days to send it back if it is not for you.

settings.heading: Kneel

settings.question: Does it need assembly?
settings.answer: No. It arrives assembled. Unfold it, snap the lock open, and it is ready.

settings.question: Can I wash the pad?
settings.answer: Yes. The pad detaches from the frame. Hose it off or wipe it down and clip it back on.
